name: Glasgow
registryBasis: Registers of Scotland publishes a Glasgow City Council INSPIRE cadastral-parcel partition. Geometry-only inspection verifies three current indicative registered-title extent polygons covering the exact WUP point; this is not a legal-boundary or complete parcel-coverage assertion.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The archive has 114,802 nonblank distinct INSPIRE IDs. All three retained native EPSG:27700 polygons are valid and cover the ranked point, but every pair has substantial positive-area overlap (see independent geometry review). No reviewed shapefile snapshot reader, fresh-file identity lookup, bounded viewport completeness or proposal binding is qualified. The runtime remains held without repairing or excluding source polygons. Indicative-title and partial-coverage notices describe scope and do not determine eligibility; server paging is not required for a complete static snapshot.
scopeLimits: Registers of Scotland publishes the Glasgow City Council (`GLA`) INSPIRE cadastral-parcel archive, updated 27 August 2026. The 37,268,375-byte public ZIP contains an EPSG:27700 `GLA_bng` Polygon shapefile and DBF with `inspireid` as a 23-character string key. A bounded anonymous GET fetched the full public archive. Reading only the INSPIRE ID column found 114,802 nonblank, distinct IDs; SHP/DBF counts match. Geometry-only selection retained three valid complete polygons, each covering the exact WUP point; GEOS reports pairwise intersections/overlaps among the three. The source states these are indicative registered title extents, with gaps/overlaps and titles absent; it is not exact legal boundary evidence or a complete cadastral coverage claim. The official publisher estimates approximately 30% of titles are not represented in the dataset; this is a partial registered-title product.
remainingUncertainty: The title extent product omits a material fraction of titles, may contain gaps/overlaps, and is not an exact legal boundary source. Runtime source refresh and feature identity continuity are also unqualified. The official specification estimates approximately 30% of titles are absent from this product.

officialSources.observation: Official dataset listing identifies Registers of Scotland cadastral parcels, all-Scotland scope and quarterly updates; the Glasgow City Council partition is separately downloadable. Listing indicates update 27 Aug 2026.

Official specification describes the schema, `inspireid` as the parcel identifier, polygons as indicative title ground parcels, and warns that gaps/overlaps and missing titles are expected; the data does not define legal boundaries.
Official Registers of Scotland INSPIRE download service lists the Glasgow authority code GLA and provides the public archive endpoint. Service page presents Open Government Licence 3 terms.
